Tulu.reason: Tulu refers to a community finetuned model (Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B), not the Tulu language.

English.reason: English refers to the language used for prompts, benchmarks (MMLU, HellaSwag) and evaluation metrics in the paper.

French.reason: French refers to the language used for French-specific datasets, finetunes, and evaluation benchmarks (MMLU-FR).

German.reason: German refers to the language used for German-specific datasets (Evol-Instruct-DE), finetunes, and evaluation benchmarks (MMLU-DE, HellaSwag-DE).
